data.gender_notes: Adhiran is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Adhiran is derived from the Sanskrit word 'adhi' meaning master or lord, and 'ran' meaning rule or control. This name is given to a child who is believed to have the intelligence and wisdom to rule or govern various aspects of life. The name Adhiran carries the meaning “Intelligent, Master” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adhiran usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
